title: Rune 1.1: adds Python, an Emacs editor, a symbol index and is now free
summary: Rune 1.1 is a development tool that now adds Python support, an Emacs editor integration, and a symbol index feature. The release also marks Rune's transition to a free model, making it more accessible to developers. This update significantly expands its language support beyond its original offerings and improves code navigation capabilities.
problem_solved: Provides developers with a unified, free development environment supporting multiple programming languages with advanced code navigation features.
why_valuable: By becoming free and adding Python support alongside existing language capabilities, Rune lowers barriers to entry for developers seeking a flexible, multi-language development tool.
